subject.title: refactor(qa): finish Matrix QA Lab ownership

question: After the redirects are restored and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103604 lands, should the exact final head be authorized to remove the temporary qa-matrix workspace package and lockfile importer?
rationale: Repository dependency policy deliberately requires a human admin or security-owner decision for manifest and lockfile graph changes, even though this patch only removes a temporary package.

options.title: Authorize the completed cleanup
options.body: Add both redirects, rebase on the landed prerequisite stack, review the final removal-only dependency delta, and authorize that exact head.

options.title: Retain the compatibility package
options.body: Keep qa-matrix registered until maintainers want a later coordinated package and documentation retirement.

options.title: Split documentation retirement
options.body: Land runtime ownership separately while postponing package and route removal to a dedicated follow-up.

recommendation.title: Authorize the completed cleanup
recommendation.body: Add both redirects, rebase on the landed prerequisite stack, review the final removal-only dependency delta, and authorize that exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Matrix QA maintenance plus participation around this PR makes them the best available routing candidate for compatibility review and coordination with an authorized dependency approver.
